snippet.title: Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue (Gameboy Color longplay)
snippet.description: Quite a nice fun power rangers game. Before I began the game I didn't know that I needed to gold medal all the levels to unlock the final boss. So for the most part I've edited out the levels I don't gold and have inserted them in later.
